from urllib.parse import urlparse
from playwright.sync_api import expect, sync_playwright
def test_search_for_t_shirts(): """Test searching for T-shirts on automation practice website""" with sync_playwright() as playwright: browser = playwright.chromium.launch(headless=False) try: page = browser.new_page()
def allow_requested_site_only(route): """Block navigation to external sites but allow all resources""" hostname = urlparse(route.request.url).hostname request_type = route.request.resource_type # Only block document navigation to other domains if (request_type == "document" and hostname not in {"automationpractice.pl", "www.automationpractice.pl"}): route.abort() else: route.continue_()
page.route("**/*", allow_requested_site_only) page.goto( "http://www.automationpractice.pl/index.php", wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000, )
assert urlparse(page.url).hostname in { "automationpractice.pl", "www.automationpractice.pl", }, f"Unexpected redirect away from the requested site: {page.url}"
search = page.locator("#search_query_top") expect(search).to_be_visible(timeout=10000) search.fill("T-shirts") search.press("Enter")
product = page.get_by_text("Faded Short Sleeve T-shirts", exact=True) product.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=15000) assert product.is_visible()
print("✓ Test passed: T-shirts search successful") finally: browser.close()
if __name__ == "__main__": test_search_for_t_shirts()
